findings.summary: Self-review of 4057dfc8: the request's deadline check raised before run_bounded's bounded wait, so the test no longer exercised the real TimeoutError branch that the original test used. Fixed in f6f92356: once the worker is blocked in the credential stub, the request's wait check returns a 10 ms budget and the wait genuinely times out; a probe confirmed the TimeoutError cause.

Out of this claim's outcome: test_stalled_event_sink_is_marked_late_when_terminal_writes_first and test_real_logger_formats_late_at_write_after_stalled_info_call in the same module still use a 50 ms wall-clock deadline and could flake the same way under a long pause. Proposed as a separate follow-up package.
